title: Jaya Ballard | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about Jaya Ballard, the Legendary Planeswalker pyromancer raising a new generation of heroes in Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Jaya Ballard is among the oldest Planeswalkers in the Multiverse. Born on Dominaria more than 1,500 years ago, she was a hot-headed, sarcastic hero who played an important part in the plane’s early history before disappearing for centuries. In recent years, she resurfaced as an older, wiser mentor to fledgling pyromancers, including her most promising student: Chandra Nalaar.
